Specification: This specification is a minimal example intended to demonstrate a tooling issue: constraints expressed in a separate constant-initialization predicate are not propagated. The module declares two integer constants t_min and t_max, constrains them in ConstInit to be integers with t_min <= t_max, and then defines a trivial behavior with Init == TRUE and Next == TRUE. The invariant Inv asserts t_min <= t_max, so the file is checking whether the constant constraint is respected when verifying the invariant under the trivial transition system.
